title: Claude designs binders against five scorpion neurotoxins
summary: In a mostly autonomous 64-hour campaign, Claude designed minibinders against five neurotoxins. External labs tested 211 designs, 17 of which met the criteria; the best (Cn2-B1 and Cn2-B2) had affinities in the low nanomolar range. Only recombinant toxins were tested, with no neutralization tests in cells or animals; Anthropic does not claim to have produced an antivenom.

evidence.tested: External labs tested 211 designs by surface plasmon resonance: Adaptyv Bio in cell-free expression and Twist Bioscience in human kidney cells; a binder needed KD of 1 µM or tighter in every replicate at both labs and no CLEC12A signal, giving 17 binders.
evidence.unknown: Only recombinant toxins were tested, with no neutralization in cells or animals; the authors do not know whether the binders neutralize venom and do not claim an antivenom; multitoxin designs failed.
evidence.ai_role: Claude selected toxin structures and hotspots, generated 318,484 designs, filtered and co-folded them, ran about 24 hours autonomously, then produced 180 selected designs after human follow-ups.
